close_reason: Already fixed: comment at email.rs:745 already says 'saturating_neg() avoids i64::MIN overflow'.
description: In handle_email_query (email.rs:687), negative position is handled as: let neg = position.saturating_neg() as usize. Using saturating_neg() prevents overflow on position == i64::MIN (the only value that overflows neg()), which would produce an incorrect large usize without the saturation. A future contributor might simplify to (-position) as usize, which would overflow silently in release builds. The saturating approach is correct and should be preserved.
title: Email/query negative position uses saturating_neg() to avoid i64::MIN overflow
